Priya (Growth): Quick sync — we need the nurture for launch week locked down. Primary goals: webinar registrations and benchmark downloads. Small, actionable items please.
Ben (Email Ops): Uploaded draft to ESP. Link: https://esp.redwood.ai/campaigns/launch-week. Need segment definitions and send windows.
Noor (Content): Shortlist of subject lines: 1) "Redwood Inference: production LLMs made predictable" 2) "Benchmark: 3x cost savings for real apps". Preference: test both.
Javier (Analytics): Proposed segments: Active Integrators (API calls last 7d), Console Trials (started walkthrough), Nurture Cold (no activity 30d+), Enterprise Hot (score>75). Suppress unsub/bounce.
Priya (Growth): Send windows: NA Tue 10:00 PT, EMEA Wed 11:00 CET. Trials get NA-friendly CTA; Enterprise get SDR CTA too.
Ben (Email Ops): Setting up A/B 50/50 for subject; holdout 5% for baseline. UTMs: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=launch_week_v1&utm_content={segment}_{variant}.
Noor (Content): CTA variants: A) "Register: Live product demo" B) "Download: 1-page benchmark". Will add a tiny customer quote (legal cleared).
MailerBot: Running suppression check...
MailerBot: Results: Active Integrators 6,143; Console Trials 2,201; Nurture Cold 8,370; Enterprise Hot 547; Total after suppression 17,261.
Javier (Analytics): We'll evaluate winner at 36h based on register_rate and download_rate. Use opens + register click as early signal.
Priya (Growth): Drip plan: Openers -> Day2 benchmark, Day6 case study. Non-openers -> Day3 subject tweak resend. Enterprise Hot -> SDR email 48h after webinar if opened.
Ben (Email Ops): Checklist for Monday send: lists exported, variants in ESP, UTM + headers set, PDF benchmark uploaded, deliverability monitor in #deliverability. I'll run a dry send to the team Tue 08:30 PT.
Noor (Content): Adding preheader: "Live demo + benchmark inside". Will paste final microcopy into the ESP tonight.
Priya (Growth): Owners: Ben (ops), Noor (copy), Javier (metrics). Lock by Mon 5pm PT. Greenlight if all clear. :rocket:
Ben (Email Ops): Greenlight pending one legal line — @Legal please confirm quote usage.
Javier (Analytics): I'll wire up dashboards and cohort tags.
Priya (Growth): Great — meeting Mon 3pm for final QA. Thanks team! :sparkles:
